dialect:
(define checklist (cbcl) @anuna
  (:resource-requirements
    ((max-depth 16)
     (max-expansion-size 4096)
     (verification-time 1000)))

  (:roles (owner (* member)))

  (extend open (to title) :from owner :to (owner member)
    (tell to :title title))

  (extend check (to item done) :from member :to (owner member)
    (tell to :item item :done done))

  (extend drop (to item) :from owner :to (owner member)
    (tell to :item item))

  (shape open
    (require :title string))
  (shape check
    (require :item string)
    (require :done bool))
  (shape drop
    (require :item string))

  (protocol
    (then begin open)
    (then open check)
    (then open drop))

  (state
    (title (last open :title))
    (items (register-per-key check :item :done drop))))
